map.不是。克重是单位面积质量，还受皮革密度（部位、鞣制程度、涂饰层）影响；同等厚度下: No. Weight per unit area is also affected by leather density (part, tanning level, finish layer), so at the same thickness a denser leather weighs more per area; the two have to be read together with the part.

map.天然皮革背脊部纤维紧密、边腹部疏松，且含水率与涂饰量不同，克重天然存在部位差；采: Natural leather has tight fibres on the back and spine and loose ones on the belly and flank, and the moisture content and finish amount differ, so weight per area naturally varies by part; purchasing usually agrees on an average or a range.

map.：一张皮重 850 g、面积 0.85 m²，克重 = 850/0.85 = 1: : a hide weighing 850 g with 0.85 m² gives 850/0.85 = 1000 g/m², a medium-thickness material. Another at 500 g and 0.25 m² gives 2000 g/m², clearly thicker. If measured in ft², 10 ft² = 0.929 m².
map.：单位面积重量 = 重量 ÷ 面积，输出单位为 g/m²。输入重量单位为克(g): : weight per unit area = weight / area, output in g/m². Enter weight in grams (g) and area in square metres (m²); if you have kilograms multiply by 1000 to get grams, and if the area is in square feet (ft²) multiply by 0.092903 to get square metres.
